name: Nakiki SE
summary: Nakiki SE, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in Germany. The company invests in bitcoin. It also provides litigation funding, mass proceedings, monetization, and distressed finance services. The company was formerly known as windeln.de SE and changed its name to Nakiki SE in March 2024. Nakiki SE was founded in 2010 and is based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
